name: Help Others
overview: Scripture calls believers to compassion and generosity toward those in need, emphasizing that showing mercy to the poor honors God and is akin to lending to the Lord Himself. The Proverbs passages highlight that kindness to the poor brings blessing and reflects reverence for the Creator. Jesus reinforces this teaching by urging His followers to give freely to those who ask and to store up heavenly treasures rather than earthly wealth. Furthermore, Luke assures that generous giving will be rewarded abundantly, encouraging a heart that gives with a bountiful spirit.
